scoring_justification: Transition levels and optical energies cannot be recomputed from the agent's total_energies alone without the bulk VBM; hence we compare agent-reported values to paper's Table II/III with tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold transition levels and optical energies and valence strings
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table II and Table III and text
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's published values
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Derived from the paper's reported numbers; they are the target of the reproduction.

required.total_energies: object mapping Ln symbol to charge state keys, values objects with keys total_energy_eV (eV) and geometry (string)
required.transition_levels: object mapping Ln to keys epsilon_plus_over_0 (eV or null) and epsilon_0_over_minus (eV or null)
required.optical_transitions: object mapping Ln (Ce, Eu) to keys absorption_eV, emission_eV, relaxation_energy_excited_eV, relaxation_energy_ground_eV (all eV)
required.valence_summary: object mapping Ln to a string describing stable valence states (e.g., '3+', '3+/4+', '3+/2+')

outputs.description: Full reproduction data: total energies, derived transition levels, optical energies, and valence assignments.

output_contract.notes: Transition levels and optical energies are derived from the provided total energies; checker will recompute and compare to hidden references with appropriate tolerances.
